content:
name: Docker image

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Published @bull-board/cli version to build the image from
        required: true
        type: string
      wait_for_publish:
        description: Poll npm until that version is installable
        default: false
        type: boolean
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Published @bull-board/cli version to build the image from
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and push
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Resolve the image tags this version owns
        id: image
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          ATTEMPTS: ${{ inputs.wait_for_publish && 40 || 1 }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolve"
          for attempt in $(seq 1 "$ATTEMPTS"); do
            if npm install "@bull-board/cli@$VERSION" --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolve" \
                 --dry-run --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-online > /dev/null 2>&1 &&
               npm view @bull-board/cli --json --prefer-online > "$RUNNER_TEMP/packument.json" &&
               node -e 'process.exit(require(`${process.env.RUNNER_TEMP}/packument.json`).versions.includes(process.env.VERSION) ? 0 : 1)'; then
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" = "$ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "@bull-board/cli@$VERSION is not installable from npm" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 15
          done

          node -e '
            const pkg = require(`${process.env.RUNNER_TEMP}/packument.json`);
            const { VERSION, IMAGE } = process.env;
            const major = VERSION.split(".")[0];
            const parts = (version) => version.split(".").map(Number);
            const newest = pkg.versions
              .filter((version) => /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(version) && version.split(".")[0] === major)
              .sort((a, b) => {
                const [x, y] = [parts(a), parts(b)];
                return x[0] - y[0] || x[1] - y[1] || x[2] - y[2];
              })
              .pop();
            const tags = [`${IMAGE}:${VERSION}`];
            if (newest === VERSION) tags.push(`${IMAGE}:${major}`);
            if (pkg["dist-tags"].latest === VERSION) tags.push(`${IMAGE}:latest`);
            console.log(`tags=${tags.join(",")}`);
          ' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          build-args: BULL_BOARD_VERSION=${{ inputs.version }}
          tags: ${{ steps.image.outputs.tags }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.description=bull-board dashboard as a standalone server, configured through the @bull-board/cli flags and BULL_BOARD_* variables
            org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ inputs.version }}
          provenance: mode=max
          sbom: true
